verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yena anuppannā vā kusalā dhammā uppajjanti uppannā vā akusalā dhammā parihāyanti yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, santuṭṭhitā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that gives rise to skillful qualities, or makes unskillful qualities decline like contentment.

verses.pali: Santuṭṭhassa, bhikkhave, anuppannā ceva kusalā dhammā uppajjanti uppannā ca akusalā dhammā parihāyantī”ti.
verses.english: When you’re contented, skillful qualities arise and unskillful qualities decline.”
